title: Implement Hartree-Fock solver
action: Implement the numerical self-consistent Hartree-Fock solver for the modified Anderson-Newns model including hydration contributions. The solver must take parameters (B, ε_F, U) and the hydration functions L(y) and R(y) as input and compute the chemisorption energy change ΔE(y), spin occupations n_σ(y), total adiabatic energy E(y), and activation barrier reduction δE_act.
description: The solver produces intermediate quantities required for the parametric sweep. The evidence log records convergence and a test run at a reference parameter set, not scored.

title: Parametric sweep of barrier reduction
action: Run the Hartree-Fock solver over a range of values for B, ε_F, and U (each varied while the other two are held fixed at typical values). For each parameter point compute δE_act. Collect the results into three arrays and write them to results.json.
description: JSON file containing the computed barrier reduction δE_act for sweeps of B, ε_F, and U.
output_schema: object with three fields: 'vary_B', 'vary_epsilon_F', 'vary_U'; each field is an array of objects with numeric keys 'parameter_value' and 'delta_E_act'.
